claim: A worker launched like a Juggernaut worker has no ask tool, so a question cannot reach the human and goes to its lead

steps.start: a real Claude Haiku worker launched with the ask-tool flag, and a control launched without it
steps: both workers are told to ask the human a question
the control opens a question dialog
the flagged worker opens no dialog and reports it has no ask tool
steps.result: the worker launched like a Juggernaut worker cannot put a question dialog in front of the human
